description: Stage one file on this server: returns a url and an upload_id. A staged file is inert until imported. A chat app that displays this server's views shows the result to the user as an upload box: they pick a video, photo or other file from their phone or computer there and it is sent without leaving the chat, and the box says in the chat when it is in. The url works for 7 days and takes the file from whoever holds it, with no other credentials; opened in a browser, it is a page to pick the file and send it, so it reaches the same files where no box is shown, including one attached in a chat that isn't handed to you. Files the user drops on their upload page, https://cuttingfloor.ai/upload, are staged too: many at once, after signing in to the same account. The box and the page also record from the microphone (a hum, a tapped rhythm, a spoken note), sent the same way as a file. It records in free time, with nothing playing under it.

bytes.description: The file size, to be refused now rather than part way if it is too big

name.description: The file's name, if known. A label only: the file the user picks on the page brings its own name, and import reads the content, not the extension

record.description: true when the file wanted is a recording the user makes now (a hum, a tapped rhythm, a spoken line): the box leads with Record. They can still pick a file

name: media.upload

expiry.description: expires_at in words: the link and a file sent through it go then unless imported

native_view.description: For apps, nothing for you to act on: an app with its own built-in version of this view (this component, this version) shows that in place of the web view

record.description: true when a recording was asked for

url.description: The staging url; no other credentials needed

title: Upload media
